source: Ram Dayal Munda 1968 Proto-Kherwarian records in the SEAlang Munda Dictionary

policy.extraction: structured HTML semantic spans; no OCR
policy.variants: only spaced tildes split source-level alternants; slash and optional-segment notation are preserved
policy.transcription: source Unicode is NFC-normalized and identity-preserved in Form and Phonemic
policy.alignment: shared locator plus gloss, then unique exact gloss; two damaged locators receive documented form-and-meaning corrections
policy.unlinked: three comparison records without a source reconstruction remain installed and unlinked
policy.glosses: terminal explicit POS labels become tags; one SEAlang scientific-name template marker is removed
policy.licence: SEAlang result page states no separate reuse licence; extracted lexical facts and source identifiers are included
